Full skill text at 5★
When an ally's HP is below 60%, grants them a [Shield] by 60% of the owner's HP for 2 turns, CD: 3 turns. Additionally restores the ally's HP by 16% of Max HP. When the [Shield] granted by the skill is broken, grants the ally [Shield] once again. This effect can only be triggered again after 2 turns.
Full skill text at 7★
When an ally's HP is below 60%, grants them a [Shield] by 60% of the owner's HP for 2 turns, CD: 2 turns. Additionally restores the ally's HP by 20% of Max HP. When the [Shield] granted by the skill is broken, grants the ally [Shield] once again. This effect can only be triggered again after 2 turns. Each time the skill is triggered, grants the ally [DMG Immunity] and the ally's Turn Meter cannot be reduced, lasting for 1 turn.
Source: game files.

Effects

  • [Shield] — Blocks some DMG.
